name: Organic Original Salty-sweet Granola
ingredientsText: Organic certified gluten-free oats, organic coconut sugar, organic coconut oil, organic sunflower seeds, organic puffed amaranth, organic quinoa flakes, organic chia seeds, organic cinnamon, sea salt
notes: Coconut sugar and coconut oil are not tree nuts. Gluten-free oats and sunflower seeds are not among the 9.
